relations.text: 2018年の上場時に1,060万株を引き受けた出資者
relations.text_en: Bought 10.6 million shares in a 2018 private placement

source.label: Cushman & Wakefield 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: C&W plc completed a concurrent private placement in which it sold 10.6 million shares to Vanke Service (Hong Kong) Co., Limited (currently known as Onewo Inc. subsequent to its Hong Kong public offering in 2022).

relations.text: 住宅ローン事業の合弁Cushman Wakefield Greystoneに40%出資
relations.text_en: Holds 40% of the Cushman Wakefield Greystone mortgage venture

source.label: Cushman & Wakefield 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Greystone JV recorded a non-cash provision for loan losses of $62.3 million, of which the Company recorded $24.9 million based on its 40% equity interest

companies.name: クラウダストラクチャー

relations.text: Cloudastructureが10-Kで、契約先の大手管理会社の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Cloudastructure names Cushman & Wakefield among property managers it has contracts with

source.label: Cloudastructure 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: we have contracts in place with five of the top 10 property management companies on the National Multifamily Housing Council's ("NMHC's") 2024 NMHC's top 50 list (Greystar Real Estate Partners, Avenue5 Residential, LLC, Cushman & Wakefield, BH Management Services, LLC and FPI Management, Inc.).

companies.name: ジョーンズ・ラング・ラサール

relations.text: JLLが10-Kで、主な競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: JLL names Cushman & Wakefield among its primary competitors

source.label: JLL 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Some of our primary competitors include large national or global firms including CBRE Group Inc., Cushman & Wakefield plc, Colliers International Group Inc., Savills plc and Newmark Group Inc.

relations.text: Newmarkが10-Kで、大手の競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Newmark names Cushman & Wakefield among large multinational competitors

source.label: Newmark 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We also compete with other large multi-national firms that have similar or overlapping service competencies to ours, including CBRE Group, Inc., Colliers International Group Inc., Cushman & Wakefield PLC, Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated, and Savills plc.

relations.text: EMCORが10-Kで、施設管理の競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: EMCOR names Cushman & Wakefield a competitor in site-based services

source.label: EMCOR 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Within our commercial and government site-based divisions, competition includes companies such as Amentum Services, Inc., IAP Worldwide Services, Inc., Fluor Corporation, Cushman & Wakefield plc, CBRE Group, Inc.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
